strings.name: Eric Schmidt
strings.summary: Trained in electrical engineering and computer science, Schmidt worked at Sun and Novell. As Google CEO from 2001 to 2011, he expanded its products and global organization with its two founders, then chaired Google and Alphabet. His work encompasses technology investment, science funding and AI policy; he entered commercial spaceflight in 2025. Google’s no-poaching agreements during his tenure also led to antitrust litigation.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; reviewed November 15, 2026. This is not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Participated in Google’s global expansion and organizational management, influencing internet platforms, technology investment and public discussion of artificial intelligence.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Electrical engineering bachelor’s degree, Princeton; master’s and doctorate, University of California, Berkeley.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Building a platform organization
strings.highlights.h1.text: Managed Google’s expansion with Page and Brin, developing infrastructure and product businesses.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Science and policy
strings.highlights.h2.text: Participated in philanthropic science funding and AI policy discussions, bringing business management experience into public affairs.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Entering commercial spaceflight
strings.timeline.t1.text: Took a leadership role at Relativity Space, extending technology management and investment into rockets.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Cofounding Schmidt Sciences
strings.timeline.t2.text: Cofounded the science nonprofit with Wendy Schmidt to support interdisciplinary research.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Chairing Alphabet
strings.timeline.t3.text: Became executive chairman of the parent company after Google’s restructuring.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Settling no-poaching litigation
strings.timeline.t4.text: Google and three other companies agreed to a $415 million settlement over workers’ allegations of restrictive recruiting agreements.
strings.timeline.t5.title: From CEO to executive chairman
strings.timeline.t5.text: Page became Google CEO while Schmidt moved to executive chairman duties.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Joining Google’s leadership
strings.timeline.t6.text: Became CEO, managing the expanding search company with Page and Brin.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Leading Novell
strings.timeline.t7.text: After Sun, became Novell CEO and gained experience running a software company.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Earning a doctorate
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed doctoral research at Berkeley after studying electrical engineering at Princeton.
